summary_en: The business's agent called the customer to discuss herbal products. The customer inquired about aloe vera juice priced at 399 rupees and hair oil priced at 499 rupees, but objected that the hair oil was too expensive. The agent could not confirm whether the aloe vera juice contained added sugar or preservatives, nor could they verify delivery availability to Kukatpally, Hyderabad. The customer requested a callback in Hindi tomorrow morning around 11, which the agent agreed to schedule. The call ended after the agent confirmed the callback note.
